query: 咱们机台上的 248nm DUV 激光器里面充的是什么气体?193nm 那台用的又是什么?
gold_standard: 248nm DUV 激光器是氪/氟(Krypton/Fluorine)激光器;193nm DUV 激光器是氩/氟(Argon/Fluorine)激光器。可补充:激光器有高压控制系统把脉冲强度控制到最高 10MW,输出端有光束导向/整形系统和波长控制系统。
success_criteria: 答出 248nm 用 Kr/F、193nm 用 Ar/F,气体名称完整且对应关系正确
evidence: --[p316]-- The 248nm DUV laser is a Krypton/Fluorine laser. The 193nm DUV laser is an Argon/Fluorine laser. The laser has a high voltage control system to control the pulse intensity up to 10MW. There is also a beam steering and shaping system on the output of the laser, as well as a wavelength control system.

query: 水准传感器的红系统和白系统是怎么分工的?红系统那束激光的波长是多少?
gold_standard: 水准传感器由红(red)和白(white)两套系统组成,基于两者的测量结果,由镜块下方的三个调平执行器(cam-disks)校正晶圆高度和倾斜。红系统使用 820nm 红外激光,捕获范围大(约 300µm),红光斑在晶圆面约 1×1mm。
success_criteria: 答出红/白两套系统、红系统激光波长 820nm,单位正确
evidence: --[p166]-- The level sensor consists of 2 systems: the red and the white system. Based on the measurements with the red and white level sensor, the three level actuators (cam-disks) underneath the mirror block are moved to correct the wafer height and tilt. The red system uses an infrared laser (820 nm) and has a large capture range ( 300 µm). The spot size of the red laser spot is about 1 x 1 mm on wafer level

query: 白光水准传感器为什么用卤素灯这种宽带光源?实际用到的波段范围是多少?
gold_standard: 白光系统用卤素灯作光源,滤光后实际只用光谱的红光部分(725-950nm)。用宽带光源的原因是使测量对工艺不敏感:薄膜干涉效应在大波长范围内被平均,调平系统在所有工艺层上效果一致。
success_criteria: 答出卤素灯、波段 725-950nm,并说明宽带使测量对工艺层不敏感(薄膜干涉被平均)
evidence: --[p170]-- The white system uses a halogen lamp as light source. This light is filtered so that effectively the red part of the spectrum is used (725 - 950 nm). The reason for having a broad band light source is that the measurement becomes process insensitive. The thin film interference effects are averaged over a large wavelength range. The leveling system works equally well on all process layers.

query: 晶圆预对准的 mark sensor 用什么光源照明?光路里加的滤光片截止波长是多少,为什么要加这个滤光片?
gold_standard: mark sensor 由卤素光源照明晶圆表面、CCD 相机接收反射信号;为防止光刻胶曝光,光经过一个红光滤光片(>600nm)滤波;相机光学识别对准标记,光学预对准需要 2 个位于对侧区域、edge clearance 大的对准标记。
success_criteria: 答出卤素光源+CCD 相机、红滤光片 >600nm、目的是防止光刻胶曝光
evidence: --[p111]-- The mark sensor consists of a halogen light source illuminating the wafer surface and a CCD camera detecting the reflected signal. To prevent exposure of the photo-resist, the light is filtered through a red filter (> 600 nm). The camera will optical recognize the alignment marks. For this optical pre-alignment we need 2 alignment marks with large edge clearance in opposite regions.

query: ARMS 上装的 IRIS 是干嘛用的?装了它之后机器放掩膜版的容量有什么变化?
gold_standard: IRIS(Integrated Reticle Inspection System)用于扫描掩膜版检查颗粒污染,并给操作员使用/拒收的建议;release 8.2 及以上系统可选装。硬件区别是颗粒探测器(IRIS 单元)取代了一个 library(port 2 或 3),因此可用掩膜版最多只有 12 片。
success_criteria: 答出 IRIS 扫描颗粒并给出使用/拒收建议,且答出其替换一个 library(port 2 或 3)、可用掩膜版降为 12 片
evidence: --[p98]-- The purpose of IRIS is to scan the reticle for the presence of particles and give an advise to the operator to use or reject the reticle. Systems with release 8.2 (or higher) can be equipped with an Integrated Reticle Inspection System (IRIS). The hardware difference for an IRIS system is that a particle detector (the IRIS unit) replaces one of the libraries (port 2 or 3). This means that a maximum of 12 reticles are available.

query: 镜头吹扫(Lens Purge)气体的配比是什么?I-line 机和 DUV 机用的一样吗?
gold_standard: 不一样。按体积百分比:I-line 用氦混合气 99.5% He + 0.5% O2;DUV 镜头充合成空气 80.0% N2 + 20.0% O2(DUV 镜头设计为充气时用合成空气,折射率与普通空气相同,且会自动产生臭氧)。
success_criteria: 两种配比均答对且数值/成分正确:I-line 99.5%He+0.5%O2,DUV 80.0%N2+20.0%O2
evidence: --[p361]-- If the Lens is designed to be air filled, like the DUV lens, synthetic air is used instead of Helium because it has the same refractive index as normal air, and also due to the fact that ozone is created automatically for DUV systems. The mixtures are (in volume %): Helium mixture (I-line ) : 99.5% He + 0.5% O2 Synthetic air (DUV) : 80.0% N2 + 20.0% O2

query: 扫描台的横向位置测量精度能做到多少?靠的是哪套测量系统?
gold_standard: 工作台横向位置由(HP)干涉仪系统测量,可测到约 0.6nm(PAS 5500 step&scan 系统能可靠测出 0.6nm 的台位变化,靠 633nm 波长 512 counts 分辨率加两次反射实现)。可补充:掩膜版台质量约 26kg,晶圆台约 44kg。
success_criteria: 答出干涉仪(HP interferometer)且精度 0.6nm,单位正确
evidence: --[p116]-- The stages are moved in X and Y by the stage motors. The mass of the reticle stage is approximately 26 kg. That of the wafer stage is approximately 44 kg. The reticle stage needs to be accelerated from rest within a few mm. This clearly requires a powerful motor. The motors need to move the stages over a considerable distance in the required direction and to position the stage at the desired location with extreme accuracy. The horizontal position of the stages is measured by interferometers. These can determine the stage position to approximately 0.6nm.

query: 掩膜版在 ARMS 上的粗预对准和细预对准,精度各是多少?
gold_standard: 预对准先在粗预对准位置做一次,再在细预对准位置重复一次;由于两套系统由相同部件构成,两次预对准精度相同,均为 ±3µm。
success_criteria: 答出粗、细预对准精度相同,均为 ±3µm
evidence: --[p91]-- This process of pre-alignment is first done at the coarse pre-alignment position and then repeated at the fine pre-alignment position. Note that since these 2 systems consist of same parts, the accuracy of both prealignment actions is the same (± 3 µm).

query: 剂量测试里重复性和准确性哪个规格更严?/500 的这两个规格值分别是多少,为什么这么定?
gold_standard: 规格值为 accuracy = 3.0%、repeatability = 0.7%;重复性规格更严,因为它对生产更关键。accuracy 的 3% 看起来高,但客户可以接受,因为它只用于把工艺带入工艺窗口,客户可自行优化;另外 /500 是把重复性和准确性分开规定,不像其他 PAS 5500 stepper 给两者之和(/300 ATP 为 1.5% sum,/500 为 3.7% sum)。
success_criteria: 答出 accuracy 3.0%、repeatability 0.7%,并指出重复性更严及其对生产更关键的原因
evidence: --[p492]-- The specification for accuracy appears high (3%). According to customers this is acceptable, because it is less critical for them. It is just used to bring in the process window, so they can optimize it themselves. spec accuracy = 3.0% spec repeatability = 0.7% The Dose Repeatability has the tighter specification since it is more critical for production. Also be aware that we specify for the /500 repeatability and accuracy separately and not the sum of the two, like all the other PAS 5500 steppers. Compare /300 ATP spec 1.5 % sum with /500 3.7% sum!

query: 可变衰减器是靠什么调节激光能量的?想要 98% 以上的透射率和 10% 的透射率,石英板分别转到多少度?
gold_standard: 可变衰减器由石英板上的介质镀膜构成,通过倾斜石英板来衰减激光束;透射率取决于镀膜板相对入射光束的角度,角度由 IL 软件选择。标称角 45 度时约透射 50%;透射率大于 98% 时角度为 40 度;10% 透射时角度为 50 度。
success_criteria: 答出靠倾斜镀膜石英板调节,且 98% 以上→40 度、10%→50 度(标称 45 度约 50%)
evidence: --[p325]-- The variable attenuator is made of a dielectric coating on a quartz plate. The variable attenuator reduces the intensity (energy) of the laser beam by tilting the quartz plate. Transmission depends on the angle of the coated plate with respect to the incoming laser beam. The angle is selected using the IL software. The nominal angle is 45, where approximately 50% of the light is transmitted. For transmissions larger than 98%, the angle is 40, and for 10% transmission, the angle is 50.

query: 扫到晶圆边缘、部分光斑落到晶圆外面时,水准控制怎么处理?All_By_LS 和 Z_By_LS 分别是什么意思?
gold_standard: 当边缘场的一部分超出晶圆边缘时,调平控制软件自动从 All_By_LS 切换到 Z_By_LS:All_By_LS 表示高度和倾斜都由水准传感器控制(考虑全部四个光斑信号,同时更新高度和倾斜);Z_By_LS 表示只有高度受水准传感器控制,不再考虑已不在晶圆上的一个或多个光斑的(失效)信号;此时只更新剩余光斑的高度(Z)信息,倾斜由之前的测量外推得到。
success_criteria: 答出 All_By_LS=高度+倾斜均受控、Z_By_LS=仅高度受控,并说明失效光斑信号被剔除、倾斜靠外推
evidence: --[p180]-- So when a part of an edge field lies beyond the wafer edge, the level control software automatically switches from All\_By\_LS, where both height and tilt are under level sensor control; i.e. taking into account signals from all four spots, updating tilt as well as height information, to Z\_By\_LS, where only the height is under level sensor control; NOT taking into account (corrupted) signals from one or more spots, which are not measuring on the wafer any more. Then only height (Z-) information is updated from the remaining spots, and the tilt is extrapolated from previous measurements.

query: ARMS 夹爪抓着掩膜版的时候,Z 向和 XY 向各有几个支撑点?哪几个是可以伸缩的?
gold_standard: Z 向有 4 个支撑点,防止掩膜版掉落,其中 2 个是可伸缩的 G-pins;XY 向有 3 个支撑点,防止掩膜版在运动中移动,其中 1 个是可伸缩的 plunger。
success_criteria: 答出 Z 向 4 点(2 个 G-pins 可伸缩)、XY 向 3 点(1 个 plunger 可伸缩)
evidence: --[p93]-- This slide shows some detail of the ARMS gripper (different for an ARMS gripper on a stepper). Note the Gpins, plunger, mechanical safety and how the reticle is supported in the gripper. There are 4 supporting points in Z, to prevent the reticle from falling down. Two of these points are the retractable G-pins. There are 3 supporting points in XY to prevent movement of the reticle during movement. One of these points is the retractable plunger.

query: IRIS 检测掩膜版上颗粒是什么原理?检查掩膜版背面时有什么前提条件?
gold_standard: IRIS 的检测原理是探测颗粒产生的散射光,散射光量是颗粒大小的度量。掩膜版顶面和底面都可检查,但检查底面时必须先装 pellicle(保护膜),否则铬图形会干扰测量。
success_criteria: 答出散射光检测且散射光量代表颗粒大小,并答出背面检查需加装 pellicle
evidence: --[p99]-- The IRIS detection principle is shown here. In case of a particle, scattered light is detected. The amount of scattered light is a measure of the size of the particle. Both top side and bottom side of a reticle can be inspected. However for the bottom side, a pellicle has to be mounted because the chrome pattern would disturb the measurement.

query: Cymer ELS 5600 激光器 1000Hz 工作时最大连续输出 10W,平均每个脉冲的能量是多少毫焦?
gold_standard: 平均单脉冲能量 = 平均功率 ÷ 脉冲频率 = 10 W ÷ 1000 Hz = 0.01 J = 10 mJ。
success_criteria: 给出算式 10W/1000Hz 并得出 10 mJ(0.01 J),数值与单位均正确

query: 扫描曝光前的那段 prescan 长度是怎么定的?按晶圆台 50ms、AGC 5ms 的稳定时间和 250mm/s 的最大扫描速度,算出来是多少毫米?
gold_standard: prescan 由各工作台同步所需时间决定:prescan 长度 = (WS_switch_settling_time + AGC_settling_time) × 最大扫描速度 = (50ms + 5ms) × 250mm/s = 0.055s × 250mm/s = 13.75mm。该值目前用于所有机型。
success_criteria: 给出算式 (50ms+5ms)×250mm/s 并得出 13.75mm,数值与单位正确
evidence: --[p178]-- The prescan is determined by the time needed to synchronize the stages. The prescan length = (WS\_switch\_settling\_time + AGC\_settling\_time) \* (maximum\_scan\_speed) In practice: Wafer stage switch settling time: 50ms AGC settling time: 5 ms Maximum scan speed: 250mm/sec. So the prescan length is 13.75 mm. At the moment this value is used for all systems.

query: 一个 airmount 最多能举多大的重量?主压板坐在三个 airmount 上,合计能撑多少牛?

Airmounts are very powerful, and can easily lift a weight of 15000 N each! --[p42]-- The main plate is placed on top of three airmounts (displayed as a spring plus a damping unit).

query: 装了 IRIS 的机器不换 SMIF 盒最多能放多少片掩膜版?先把 IRIS 占了哪个库查清楚,再按每个盒子的容量算一下。
gold_standard: 先检索到 IRIS 单元替换掉 port 2 或 3 的一个 library(剩 2 个 library);再检索到 ARMS 有三个 library,每个 SMIF 盒装 6 片掩膜版(无 IRIS 时 3×6=18 片)。因此装 IRIS 后最多可用掩膜版 = 2 × 6 = 12 片。
success_criteria: 先答出 IRIS 占用 port 2/3 的一个 library、每盒 6 片,再算出 12 片(对比无 IRIS 的 18 片)
evidence: --[p98]-- The hardware difference for an IRIS system is that a particle detector (the IRIS unit) replaces one of the libraries (port 2 or 3). This means that a maximum of 12 reticles are available. --[p88]-- With ARMS three libraries are present. This means that a maximum of 18 reticles are available without operator intervention. On every library a SMIF (standard mechanical interface) box (6 reticles) or a single SMIF POD (1 reticle) can be loaded.

query: 晶圆表面超出白光水准传感器的捕获范围时机器怎么办?先查白光的捕获范围有多大,再看靠哪套系统把它拉回来、那套系统用的什么光源。
gold_standard: 白光系统捕获范围很小,约 ±23µm(白光系统才是真正用于高度/倾斜测量的系统)。全局调平时先用红系统把晶圆表面拉进白光系统的捕获范围,红系统捕获范围大(约 300µm),使用 820nm 红外激光(红光斑在晶圆面约 1×1mm)。
success_criteria: 答出白光捕获范围约 ±23µm,且指出由红系统(捕获范围约 300µm、820nm 红外激光)先把晶圆拉入白光捕获范围

The white level sensor is the system that is used for the actual height and tilt measurements. --[p173]-- The red system is used to bring the wafer surface in the capture range of the white system. --[p166]-- The red system uses an infrared laser (820 nm) and has a large capture range ( 300 µm).

query: 这本书里有没有讲 EUV(13.5nm)光刻机的光源和分辨率指标?我想跟 DUV 的对比一下。

query: 标准 Reticle 上 TIS 标记是怎么布置的?每个标记由哪几段组成,图像传感器总共用几个探测器?跟 RIS 比测量原理差在哪?
gold_standard: 标准 Reticle 上有五个 TIS 标记(RIS 系统用三个 reticle stage 上的 RIS 标记);每个 TIS fiducial mark 由四段(Txh、Txv、Tyh、Tyv)和称为 ratio mark 的第五段组成;图像传感器每段一个探测器,共五个,当 WS TIS fiducial mark 的图形与投影图像完全重叠时强度最大。与 RIS 的区别:TIS 是把图像对准到标记上做绝对测量(结合水准传感器/LVDT 与 HP 干涉仪的台位数据得到 aerial image 绝对位置),而 RIS 测量的是三个标记产生的光栅干涉图样,数据为相对值。
success_criteria: 答出 5 个 TIS 标记、每标记 4 段+ratio mark、共 5 个探测器,并说明 TIS 绝对测量 vs RIS 干涉图样相对测量
evidence: --[p307]-- In summary, there are five TIS marks on the Standard Reticle (the RIS system employs three reticle stage RIS marks). Each TIS fiducial mark consists of four segments (Txh, Txv, Tyh and Tyv) and a fifth segment called the ratio mark . --[p306]-- The image sensor measures the intensity of the image (for each segment one detector, so five in total)(maximum intensity occurs when the features of the WS TIS fiducial mark are completely overlapped by the projected image), while the position of the image is determined using the wafer stage position data supplied by the level sensor (and the LVDTs) and the HP interferometers. This results in the absolute position of the aerial image being determined. --[p307]-- Image Quality Control software can then process the results obtained from aligning to the aerial image (as opposed to measuring the interference patterns generated by the three IS marks in the RIS system) and compare the measured positions with the initial system values, in order to calculate the system drifts.

query: 对准系统只用 8.0µm 光栅时捕获范围多大?加了 8.8µm 光栅为什么就能扩到 ±44µm?这两种光栅在掩膜版级别实际周期是多少?
gold_standard: 只用 8.0µm 光栅时最大强度每 8.0µm 出现一次,捕获范围只有 ±4µm。为把捕获范围从 ±4µm 扩到 ±44µm 采用 vernier(游标)系统:X 和 Y 各用两个光栅,一个为名义周期,另一个比名义周期宽 10%(即 8.8µm);对准系统认为两个正弦同时重合才算对准,位移达 88µm 才会出现新的对准位置。在掩膜版级别两光栅实际周期为 32µm 和 35.2µm,习惯上仍称 8.0µm 和 8.8µm 以便与晶圆级线宽对应。
success_criteria: 答出仅 8.0µm 时 ±4µm、vernier 扩到 ±44µm(第二光栅宽 10%)、掩膜版级实际周期 32µm/35.2µm、88µm 处出现新对准位置
evidence: --[p219]-- To increase the capture range from +/- 4 µm to +/- 44 µm, a vernier system is used. To achieve this, there are two gratings for both X and Y alignment. One grating has the nominal grating period, and one is 10% wider than nominal. With only an 8.0 µm grating the maximum intensity would occur every 8.0 µm, giving the system a capture range of +/- 4 µm. Only if the displacement is 88 µm will a new aligned position be found. --[p213]-- At reticle level the periods of the two gratings are 32 µm, and 35.2 µm respectively. However they are always referred to as 8.0 and 8.8 µm, to keep it similar to the line widths at wafer level.

query: 如果晶圆从正确位置沿 X 偏了 24µm,按书上的公式,8.8µm 光栅会显示多大误差?这时 8.0µm 光栅显示多少?
gold_standard: 24µm = 3 × 8µm,即 n=3。按书上公式,8.8µm 光栅误差 = 8 × (n/10) µm = 8 × 0.3 µm = 2.4µm;此时 8.0µm 光栅仍显示零误差。只有位移达 88µm 才会找到新的对准位置。
success_criteria: 给出 n=3、算式 8×(3/10)µm,得出 2.4µm,并说明 8.0µm 光栅仍为零误差
evidence: --[p219]-- If the wafer is shifted over n times 8 µm from its correct position, the 8 µm grating still shows zero error, but the 8.8 µm grating shows an error of 8 x (n/10) µm. Only if the displacement is 88 µm will a new aligned position be found.

query: 剂量均匀性要求 die 上每个部分至少打多少个激光脉冲?按激光器 1000Hz 的脉冲频率,扫过一个点最少要多长时间?
gold_standard: 对 /500 及以上机型,剂量均匀性通常要求 die 的每个部分至少 30 个激光脉冲才能获得足够的剂量均匀性。所需时间 = 脉冲数 ÷ 脉冲频率 = 30 ÷ 1000 Hz = 0.03 s = 30 ms(基于 Cymer ELS 5600 激光器 1000Hz 工作频率)。
success_criteria: 答出至少 30 个脉冲,并给出算式 30/1000Hz = 0.03s(30ms),数值与单位正确
evidence: --[p482]-- For the /500 and up, dose uniformity typically requires a minimum of 30 laser pulses on each part of the die to get a sufficient dose uniformity. --[p318]-- Cymer ELS 5600 laser, operating at 1000 Hz, giving 10 Watt maximum continuous output power; pulse energy under scanner control (based on feedback signal from Energy Sensor in AERIAL illuminator).

query: 第一次跑 FOCAL 该用哪种能量方式?之后日常用单能量方式维持焦平面时,scanner 布局的 FOCAL reticle 要曝光多少次?FOCAL 和 FEM 测出的焦点值差多少?
gold_standard: FOCAL 有多能量(multiple energies)和单能量(single energy)两种方式:多能量方式用于确定特定光刻胶类型和胶厚下的最佳曝光能量,首次跑 FOCAL 应先用它;最佳剂量已知且工艺稳定后,日常用单能量方式维持焦平面。单能量方式下,FOCAL reticle(139 标记 stepper 布局或 247 标记 scanner 布局)在 16 个不同 focus 高度/offset 的场曝光,只需 16 次曝光(16x1)。FOCAL 与 FEM 的焦点值存在偏移,差约 0.1µm,须在客户现场确定;FOCAL 测得的焦点值比 FEM 更准确。
success_criteria: 答出首次用多能量方式确定最佳剂量、单能量方式 16 次曝光(16x1)、FOCAL 与 FEM 焦点值差约 0.1µm 且 FOCAL 更准
evidence: --[p20]-- There are 2 different ways to perform FOCAL: With multiple energies or with single energy. The multiple energy option is used to determine the best energy for a specific photoresist and photoresist thickness. --[p21]-- The image on the reticle consisting of 139 marks (stepper layout) or 247 marks (scanner layout) is exposed at 16 different focus heights. When the best exposure dose is already known, the single energy option can be used. This means only 1 exposure dose is used to expose the FOCAL reticle at 16 fields with 16 different focus offsets. This involves only 16 exposures (16x1). --[p22]-- Once FOCAL has been done successfully for the first time, FOCAL can be used for maintaining the focal plane and a FEM is not necessary anymore. Note that there is an offset between the focus value of a FEM and FOCAL. This difference can be around 0.1 µm and has to be determined at the customers site. The focus value determined with FOCAL is more accurate than with FEM.
